name: x3d-stem-electron-cloud/v1
purpose: Electron Cloud Observatory (x3d.STEM flagship 3). Accepting under it means: the scene is grammatical and meaningful on the fork with no known trap; every state declares its model and limits; the numerical hydrogen solver matches the exact energies, degeneracy, Laguerre radial functions, <r>, virial theorem and node counts within declared limits, with the observed order of convergence; the Lyman-alpha superposition reproduces the exact transition energy and dipole on the radial grid and on its 3D frames; every reference mesh is closed, its volume agrees with the field, and the published precision moves the surface less than the declared limit; payloads inflate to their recorded bytes; the builder and the radial solver are the shipped ones; and a browser rebuilt every mesh from the verified fields and matched the builder's reference, with playback following the scene's own route.
limitations: Page traps are static pattern and syntax checks of src/*.js against the X_ITE contracts the Loom has paid for (law 32); the page's browser evidence remains the behaviour witness.
Behaviour is one headless Chromium on one machine (Apple M3, ANGLE Metal): mesh counts and volumes and playback order, not pixels or frame rate.
No offline-render comparison of browser frames (eyes) for this study yet.
The Lyman-alpha wavelength witness is a units check (its error equals the transition energy's); the model omits the reduced-mass correction, stated in every case.
The shared library lib/stemkit lies outside the candidate; its hashes are recorded in each case (external_dependencies) but not gated.
Grammar and Meaning ran on the local x3d_mcp fork checkout, not the family pin.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
